//! Declaration formatting corpus: preserve public contracts, comments, and literals.
//! A second module documentation paragraph with Unicode: café, 世界, →.

use std::{collections::{BTreeMap, HashMap}, fmt::Debug, marker::PhantomData};
pub use crate::model::{Record, RecordId as Id};
extern crate alloc;

/// Configuration constant with its value intentionally absent from an overview.
pub const DEFAULT_LIMIT: usize;
static mut REGISTRY: Option<Registry>;
pub type Callback = for<'request> unsafe extern "C" fn(&'request [u8], *mut u8) -> usize;
type ResultMap<Value> = Result<BTreeMap<String, Vec<Value>>, Box<dyn std::error::Error + Send + Sync>>;
pub type Fixed<const SIZE: usize> = [u8; SIZE];
pub type Pair = (u32, Vec<(String, Option<u64>)>);

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
/// Named fields retain their documentation and visibility.
pub struct Configuration<'config, Value: Debug, const SIZE: usize>
where
    Value: Clone + 'config,
{
    /// A borrowed map with nested generic arguments.
    pub entries: &'config BTreeMap<String, Vec<Value>>,
    pub(crate) callback: Callback,
    #[cfg(feature = "extra")]
    /// Conditionally available bytes.
    pub bytes: [u8; SIZE],
    private: PhantomData<&'config Value>,
}

/// A unit struct remains distinct from an empty named or tuple struct.
pub struct Marker;
pub struct EmptyNamed {}
pub struct EmptyTuple();

/// Documented tuple fields must never be merged into line comments.
pub struct Position(
    /// Horizontal and vertical coordinates in world units.
    pub Vec2,
);

pub struct Packet<'packet>(
    /// The packet identifier belongs to the caller.
    pub u64,
    #[cfg(feature = "extra")]
    /// The payload can include commas and spaces in its contents.
    pub(crate) &'packet [u8],
    /* Block comment beside a nested tuple. */
    (Option<u32>, Result<Vec<u8>, String>),
);

#[non_exhaustive]
pub enum Event<'event, Value> {
    /// No payload.
    Idle,
    /// Anonymous fields with a nested type.
    Received(&'event Value, Option<(u32, u64)>),
    /// Field documentation inside an enum tuple also needs a newline.
    Progress(
        /// Number of completed bytes.
        u64,
        /// Total number of bytes.
        u64,
    ),
    Failed {
        /// A quoted marker is text, not a comment delimiter: "//".
        message: String,
        retry: bool,
    },
}

pub unsafe trait Storage<Value>: Send + Sync
where
    Value: Debug,
{
    type Error: Debug;
    const CAPACITY: usize;
    /// Writes a value and reports its stable key.
    fn insert(&mut self, key: &str, value: Value) -> Result<u64, Self::Error>;
    fn read<'read>(&'read self, key: &str) -> Option<&'read Value>;
    fn callback(&self, callback: impl FnOnce(&Value) -> bool + Send) -> bool;
}

impl<'config, Value: Debug + Clone, const SIZE: usize> Configuration<'config, Value, SIZE> {
    pub fn new(entries: &'config BTreeMap<String, Vec<Value>>, callback: Callback, bytes: [u8; SIZE]) -> Self;
    pub fn entries(&self) -> impl Iterator<Item = (&String, &Vec<Value>)>;
    pub fn split(&mut self) -> (&mut Callback, &mut PhantomData<&'config Value>);
    pub async fn fetch(&self, request: &str) -> ResultMap<Value>;
    pub const fn capacity(&self) -> usize;
    pub unsafe fn pointer(&self) -> *const Value;
}

unsafe impl<Value: Debug> Storage<Value> for Registry {
    type Error = String;
    const CAPACITY: usize;
    fn insert(&mut self, key: &str, value: Value) -> Result<u64, Self::Error>;
    fn read<'read>(&'read self, key: &str) -> Option<&'read Value>;
    fn callback(&self, callback: impl FnOnce(&Value) -> bool + Send) -> bool;
}

/// Long parameter lists must retain commas within nested types and callback arguments.
pub fn dispatch<'request, Value: Debug>(registry: &'request mut Registry, entries: Result<Vec<(String, Value)>, String>, callback: for<'item> fn(&'item Value, usize) -> bool, options: &[Option<Value>]) -> Result<(), String>
where
    Value: Send + Sync + 'request;

pub unsafe extern "C" fn exported(buffer: *const u8, length: usize) -> i32;
pub fn never() -> !;

extern "C" {
    pub fn external_call(buffer: *const u8, length: usize, callback: Option<unsafe extern "C" fn(i32, *mut u8)>);
    pub static mut EXTERNAL_STATE: i32;
}

#[path = "nested/module.rs"]
pub mod external_module;

pub mod nested {
    //! Nested documentation stays attached to this module.
    pub(crate) use super::Marker;
    pub struct Handle {
        pub id: u64,
        pub label: &'static str,
    }
    impl Handle {
        /// Returns the stable identifier.
        pub fn id(&self) -> u64;
    }
    pub mod inner {
        pub enum State { Ready, Waiting, Complete }
        pub fn transition(state: State, reason: &str) -> State;
    }
}

/// Paragraph wrapping may change whitespace but not documentation contents.
/// The returned guard keeps a caller-owned object alive until the callback finishes, including when an operation returns an error.
///
/// ```rust
/// let literal = "a deliberately long example with // comment markers and  spaces that must stay intact";
/// ```
/// - Preserve a Markdown list item.
///   Preserve its continuation.
#[doc = "Literal documentation with  two spaces and // markers"]
pub fn documented(request_identifier: &str, callback_identifier: impl FnOnce(&str, usize) -> bool, registry_identifier: &mut Registry) -> bool;
